summary: Iteration 4 testing COMPLETE. Backend: 55/55 pytest PASS (40 regression from iter1-3 + 15 NEW iter4 tests). All new endpoints work exactly as specified: (1) POST /api/sos with {lat,lng} inserts sos_alert AND creates a chat message in EVERY group the user belongs to; response has sos_id (sos_ prefix), notified_groups, message_ids[], maps_url (google.com/maps?q=lat,lng). Verified by listing messages in both groups and confirming '🆘 EMERGENCY' text is present. (2) POST /api/sos with 0 groups → 200, notified_groups=0, message_ids=[]. (3) POST /api/rides/{id}/share returns {token,url}; repeated calls return SAME token (idempotent). DELETE /api/rides/{id}/share revokes → subsequent GET /api/public/rides/{token} and GET /api/public/ride/{token} both return 404. (4) GET /api/public/rides/{token} JSON: NO auth required, returns ride+points+owner_name. (5) GET /api/public/ride/{token} HTML: 200 text/html, contains <title> with ride name; ride WITH points contains '<polyline points='; empty ride contains 'No GPS points'; bad token returns 404 with HTML. Frontend (Expo web, 390x844) verified via browser automation with real backend: (a) Map tab shows red pill SOS button (testID map-sos-button, 64x64 in bottom-right at x=310,y=604) with pulse ring. (b) Tapping opens sos-sheet modal. (c) SEND SOS (sos-open-confirm-button) → confirmation view with sos-confirm-button. (d) Confirming with 1 group membership → 'SOS BROADCASTED — Alert sent to 1 group. Your live location was shared via chat.' with CLOSE button (sos-close-button). (e) Ride detail shows SHARE RIDE button (testID share-ride-button) below DOWNLOAD GPX (testID download-gpx-button). (f) With navigator.share removed, clicking share triggers clipboard fallback and shows 'Public link copied to clipboard!' via testID ride-message. (g) Rides list (testID rides-screen) loads without rides-error toast when /api/rides responds OK. NO deprecated shadow* warnings observed on iter4 screens (SOS button uses boxShadow correctly at src/sos.tsx:176). Regression: register/login (email + Google OAuth entry) work.

ui_bugs.issue: When /api/auth/register returns 422 (e.g., blocked email TLD like .test), the register-error box renders '[object Object]' instead of the API error detail. Not blocking iter4 flows (falls back to any valid email) but a UX defect — the error handler is stringifying the FastAPI 422 detail array as the raw object. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(auth)/register.tsx and its error-handling path.

action_items: (Optional / low priority) Fix register-error stringification in /app/frontend/app/(auth)/register.tsx so the FastAPI 422 detail object is rendered as readable text (e.g., extract .detail[0].msg or JSON.stringify) instead of '[object Object]'. Reproduces by attempting registration with a .test TLD email or omitting a required field.

(Chore, still pending from iter3) Migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow across other screens to fully silence RN-web deprecation warnings. Iter4 SOS button (src/sos.tsx:176) already uses boxShadow correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:855-899 (emergency_sos): correctly inserts sos_alerts document AND fans out one chat message per group. maps_url formatted with 6-decimal precision. Handles 0-groups case gracefully (empty msg_ids list, notified_groups=0). No _id leaks (all inserts return their own dict).

server.py:903-920 (create_ride_share): idempotency implemented by checking existing ride_shares document for (ride_id, user_id) before creating a new one; token reuse verified via test_share_is_idempotent_same_token. 404 correctly enforced for foreign rides via the same query filter.

server.py:929-949 (public_ride_json) and server.py:952-1052 (public_ride_html) correctly exposed WITHOUT get_current_user dependency — public access works with no auth header. HTML escapes '<' and '&' in name/owner_name (line 986-987) but does NOT escape '"' or '>'; low risk since these are only quoted in <title> text content, not attributes. Consider full HTML escaping via html.escape() for defense-in-depth.
server.py:923-926 (revoke_ride_share): uses delete_many scoped to (ride_id, user_id) → prevents cross-user revocation. Returns {revoked: count} — matches contract; frontend can distinguish 0 from >0.
server.py:1041: polyline vs 'No GPS points' branch is a clean inline ternary in the f-string; verified both branches render correctly.
src/sos.tsx: SosButton uses boxShadow (not deprecated shadow* props) at line 176 — good. Modal correctly wired to three views (initial → confirming → result). All interactive elements have testIDs.

map.tsx:129-131 positions SosButton absolute at right:spacing.lg, bottom:96+spacing.lg — bottom-right floating pill above the ACTIVE RIDERS bottom bar. Verified visually at x=310,y=604 on 390x844 viewport with 64x64 hitbox (meets 44px touch target).

rca_of_issue: No new bugs found in iter4 backend or in the primary iter4 frontend flows. One pre-existing minor frontend UX defect surfaced during registration testing: register-error renders '[object Object]' on 422 responses because the error handler doesn't extract .detail from the FastAPI validation payload. Reproduction: POST /api/auth/register with an EmailStr-rejected TLD (e.g., @foo.test) → 422 → UI shows '[object Object]'. Mitigation: in /app/frontend/app/(auth)/register.tsx, when the API error is an object, extract err.detail?.[0]?.msg or JSON.stringify(err.detail) before setting the error state. Not iter4-scope, so main agent may defer.
